_help: Ambient scenery life around the player (no gameplay). Read by scripts/Ambient.cs. sound: false = no ambience sound layers (birds, crickets, wind, dungeon air, one-shots), only music (Sfx.cs).

soundscape._help: layers = looping files in assets/audio/ambient (file = name without extension); each entry's loudness vol (0..1, times the Ambient slider) applies when ALL its 'when' conditions hold; the same file may appear twice (loudest wins). Only maxLayers loudest play, crossfaded over fade seconds. when: time day|night (blends with dusk), realm light|shadow, biome / notBiome = substrings of the land's default biome id, water = metres to a lake/river/sea, place = inside a POI, alt = hero metres above sea. oneshots = sfx ids from assets/audio/sfx played at a random point 'dist' metres around the hero, one every 'every' seconds (ids with no file are skipped); pitch = [min,max].
